country.evidence_source: In Hong Kong, schools are ranked based on measures of student discipline and academic performance. Band I schools are at the top, followed by Band II schools, and, finally, Band III schools. The final sample consisted of 346 students (126 boys and 220 girls) and their mothers. Overall, this represented 90% of those students asked to participate (three classes, each in two coeducational schools, and two classes of an all-girls school). The sample accounted for 0.4% of the total 7th-grade student population in Hong Kong.

sample_type.evidence_source: Three schools selected for reasons of convenience participated in the present study.

ethnicity.evidence_source: Similar to most students enrolled in government schools in Hong Kong, all of the participants were ethnic Chinese and had lived in Hong Kong for more than 7 years.
